title: WashU students build skills, networks through internships
summary_en: About 400 WashU students turned out for “What’s Your Summer Scoop?”, hosted by the Center for Career Engagement. Students shared information about their internships, fellowships, research experiences, summer jobs and volunteer service. The center will use that information to provide experiential learning resources.
title_cn: WashU students build skills, networks through internships

title: Advice from the frontline of alpha-gal syndrome
summary_en: WashU Medicine allergist and immunologist Maya Jerath, MD, PhD, has treated over 650 patients with alpha-gal, a potentially life-threatening allergic reaction triggered by tick bites — and the prevalence is increasing rapidly, she says.
title_cn: Advice from the frontline of alpha-gal syndrome

title: Family resilience can help protect children from climate change
summary_en: As climate change brings more extreme weather events, strengthening families before disasters strike can help protect children’s health and well-being, says Mary McKay, professor at the WashU Brown and an expert on child mental health.
title_cn: Family resilience can help protect children from climate change
